scope: all semantic claim-role instances before integration

approved_mechanisms.A: realized by the governed role instance
approved_mechanisms.B: explicitly allocated to another same-claim permitted instance within frozen validator scope
approved_mechanisms.C: explicitly proven satisfied by the primary realization within frozen validator scope

invariants: a role-requirement registry is explicit and semantic_condition_ids plus semantic_dependency_ids must match it exactly; claim conditions are never automatically copied to secondary roles
every semantic requirement has exactly one closure record
the owner exists, carries the same claim, is role-realizable, can realize the requirement, and exposes the named renderer input field
UNIT scope requires the owner in the same emitted unit; PARAGRAPH scope requires the owner in the same explicit paragraph binding
mechanism C requires a PASS proof against the frozen validator's actual scope semantics
ambient or neighboring text without an ownership record never closes a requirement
role feasibility is true only when lexical role feasibility, condition feasibility, and dependency feasibility are all true
execution_order: after role/lexical feasibility and before any visible prose or renderer call
